subject: secrapp 2.0 - spatially explicit capture-recapture in a GUI

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: secrapp 2.0 - spatially explicit capture-recapture in a GUI
parts:
The Shiny application 'secrapp' has been updated for secr 5.1 and is available at https://www.stats.otago.ac.nz/secrapp/, no installation required. Changes are mostly minor.

See GitHub for the development version, and check out the step-by-step guide. Please report bugs as Issues on GitHub - after checking they are reproducible.
